name: webhook-platform-backend
description: Webhook platform: idempotent event intake, transactional outbox to RabbitMQ, at-least-once delivery workers with per-endpoint concurrency limits, signed requests with secret rotation, SSRF-safe connections, retries in PostgreSQL, replay, and a mock receiver with fault toggles

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,pub,sched,work1,work2,recv -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:publisher" "npm run dev:scheduler" "npm run dev:worker1" "npm run dev:worker2" "npm run dev:receiver"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,pub,sched,work1,work2,recv "tsx src/api/index.ts" "tsx src/publisher/index.ts" "tsx src/scheduler/index.ts" "WORKER_PORT=3101 WORKER_ID=worker-1 tsx src/worker/index.ts" "WORKER_PORT=3102 WORKER_ID=worker-2 tsx src/worker/index.ts" "tsx src/receiver/index.ts"
